eye.rule: After TOP5 is frozen, independently re-audit every runner outside TOP5 and select at most one horse with the strongest concrete race-specific case to outperform its frozen ability rank today. Never auto-select rank 6. Popularity, odds, market data, external tipsters, and named-jockey preferences are prohibited. Return null when no candidate has sufficient concrete evidence.
eye.maiden_component: MAIDEN_RESIDUAL_EYE_0.1 may be used as supplemental evidence in MAIDEN but is not a gate for other supported classes.
eye.validated_evidence: Historical 2026-01..08 check found one-per-race outside-TOP5 candidate top3 rates across MAIDEN, CLASS1, CLASS2_3 and OPEN_GRADED; time-split stability confirmed, with OPEN_GRADED treated more cautiously.

content.goal: Freeze pre-race JRA ability ranking using only validated components; keep market data separate.
content.name: BAKEN LAB JRA MAIN / REBUILD 0.3
content.scope: JRA flat races only; obstacle races unsupported

ranking.unsupported_segments: Do not force a ranking when candidate data_status is unsupported or no flat history.

content_evaluation_contract.comments: optional; missing cannot lower score or block
content_evaluation_contract.selection: compare every runner independently on prior as-of race content, course surface distance, winner gaps, positional work, pace and opponent quality with verified facts only; relative evidence must be assessed against all rivals, not one fixed bump
content_evaluation_contract.market_data: no market odds or popularity in ability evaluation
content_evaluation_contract.rank_effect: Manual whole-field ranking may deviate from baseline candidate when race-specific comparative evidence is explicitly stated
content_evaluation_contract.claim_context: Use runner_history and optional runner_content_evidence if present; if absent continue normally; an authorized read-only diagnostic may supply historic content but is never mandatory
content_evaluation_contract.ranking_guard: no automatic rank6 promotion; do not blindly promote all small-margin finishers, compare with displaced top5 and protect strong form
content_evaluation_contract.source_cutoff: only events demonstrably known before this race start
content_evaluation_contract.history_window: use four verified merged runs; add older factual racing evidence only where source and as-of are certain
content_evaluation_contract.incident_guard: never infer an unverified break, interference, or wide trip
content_evaluation_contract.surface_switch: first turf or dirt is uncertainty, not zero ability or guaranteed uplift

principles.missing_data: Do not infer unavailable facts; mark missing.
principles.independent_evaluation: Do not use external tipster rankings or named-jockey preferences as ranking rules.

content.change_policy: Content-aware full-runner comparison in new races only. No formula-based boost without evidence. Legacy BASE_CORE_0.1 remains the statistically validated baseline; content assessment is experimental until monitored. Existing FROZEN unchanged.

payload.notes: Forward-only pilot of race-content comparative reasoning. BASE_CORE 0.1 untouched. No forced upshift, FROZEN rewrite, EYE or market change. Source evidence optional.
